name: ai-instructions
title: AI Instructions Manager
description: A settings popover for choosing how an assistant should reply. It lists instruction presets with checkboxes, filters them by typing, previews a rule on hover, and lets you create a new one.
use: You want a compact popover to switch several AI behaviour presets on and off while typing.
avoid: The choices must stay on screen: they hide behind a trigger and the popover closes on an outside click.
a11y: Toggled rows are visual divs with no aria-checked, so screen readers do not hear which presets are on. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small ghost button with a gear icon, the word "Instructions" and a round count badge sits under a muted caption. Opened upward, a dark rounded popover shows a search field, a "Presets" label and four rows, each with a square checkbox, a bold title and a grey description; a footer row reads "+ New Instruction".
behaves: Clicking the button raises the popover above it. Typing filters the rows live, and hovering a row after a short delay opens a side card with the full instruction text. Clicking a row ticks its checkbox and updates the count badge.
customise: Pass an instructions array and controlled or default active ids; the search, rows, footer and create dialog are composed as child parts. Colours come from theme tokens.
weight: moderate: A popover tree with a command list, hover card and dialog, mounted on demand.
demo: Button labelled Instructions; presets Be Concise, Add Code Comments, Include Examples and Formal Tone.
issues: The popover opens above the trigger, so it can clip at the top of a short viewport.
Search matches only row titles; the descriptions are not searched.
Row checkboxes are plain divs with no accessible checked state.
polishWhy: Tidy popover with search and hover preview; the fixed 320px width and top anchoring limit it.
